subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Demographic That Runs Television
description: A quick, practical guide to The Demographic That Runs Television.

hook.text: Advertisers don't care how many people watch. They care how many 18-to-49-year-olds watch.

buildup.text: The 18-49 demographic is considered the prime spending group.

discovery.text: Shows with older audiences get canceled despite high viewership.

twist.text: This system marginalized programming for older, rural, and lower-income viewers.

climax.text: The 18-49 obsession shaped what TV looks like, who it's for, and whose stories get told. Demographics became destiny.

punchline.text: Television doesn't serve the most viewers. It serves the most valuable ones.

quiz.question: Why does the 18-49 age demographic drive television advertising rates?
options: Advertisers consider them the prime spending group worth more per viewer
They are the largest age group
